title: Slemani Museum, Hamilton Road & Rawanduz
full_text:
Breakfast at the hotel or local breakfast in the bazaar.
Visiting the Slemani Museum, the second largest archaeological museum in Iraq.
Start heading to Erbil.
Drive through the famous Hamilton road, built in the 1930s to link the region.
Visit Rawanduz Valley and enjoy the scenery of the area.
Arrival in Erbil and check-in to the hotel.
